module.title: Days 1–10 | Competition Mastery Module
module.description: Production candidate: authored topic-driven AI & Technology Challenge curriculum.

lessons.title: AI concepts & terminology
lessons.objective: Build competition-ready understanding of ai concepts & terminology and apply it accurately to unfamiliar questions.
lessons.core_teaching_content: AI and technology reasoning requires clear distinctions among data, algorithms, models, applications and users. Machine learning systems learn patterns from data; model quality depends on the task, data and evaluation method. Generative AI can produce content but may produce incorrect or unsupported outputs. Technology questions should also consider privacy, security, bias, safety and human oversight. Treat impressive output as something to evaluate, not automatic evidence of correctness. In this lesson, focus specifically on ai concepts & terminology. Identify the defining concepts, the distinctions that commonly cause mistakes, and the evidence or procedure needed to justify an answer. Practise moving from recognition to application: first identify what the question is testing, then select a method, perform the reasoning carefully, and verify the result against the wording and constraints. Keep an error log that records the misconception or decision error, not just the correct answer.
examples: A AI & Technology Challenge question on ai concepts & terminology should be solved by identifying the key clue, applying the relevant principle, and checking the option against all stated conditions.
Create a new ai concepts & terminology scenario with one tempting distractor. Explain why the correct response is supported and why the distractor fails.
lessons.practical_activity: Complete a focused AI & Technology Challenge activity on ai concepts & terminology. Build a small table, diagram, worked example, speaking sample, writing sample or practice set as appropriate to the subject, then explain the reasoning behind the result.
lessons.guided_practice: Work through three scaffolded tasks on ai concepts & terminology: model the first, prompt the second, and require independent justification on the third. Ask the learner to identify the exact clue, rule or evidence used before confirming the answer.
independent_practice: Solve three unfamiliar questions on ai concepts & terminology without viewing the answer.
Create one new example and solve it using the lesson method.
Review one distractor or error and explain why it is wrong.
lessons.assessment_checkpoint: Complete an eight-item AI & Technology Challenge checkpoint focused on ai concepts & terminology. Target at least six correct and justify every uncertain response.
lessons.student_task: Produce one finished AI & Technology Challenge task demonstrating ai concepts & terminology and record the reasoning, evidence or performance criteria used.
lessons.tutor_guidance: Coach the learner toward evidence-based reasoning and precise terminology. Ask for the method before giving correction, and turn each error into a reusable rule or practice target. This lesson remains suitable for self-learning.
lessons.reflection_completion: Record one strength, one mistake pattern and one concrete action for improving ai concepts & terminology in the next practice session.
lessons.daily_flow: Learn → Worked Example → Guided Practice → Independent Practice → Check → Reflect
